name: cs50
description: The CS50 problem-set grader on the learner's own machine. Input is one cs50 subcommand line: 'list' (the course's problems and which are set up locally), 'start <problem>' (create the problem's folder with its starter files and print the task), 'task <problem>' (print the task), 'check <problem>' (grade the learner's work with check50 --local: one [ok]/[FAIL] line per requirement), 'style <problem>' (run style50 on the source file), 'submit-info <problem>' (print the submit50 command — the learner submits himself; this tool never submits), 'doctor' (report what is missing), 'setup' (install check50/style50/libcs50 without sudo). Problem ids are the course's own (e.g. 'mario-less', 'hello-world'). Coach from the check output; never hand over a solution unless the learner asks for one after trying.
inputDescription: cs50 subcommand, e.g. 'start mario-less' or 'check mario-less'
